scope: Runtime core source roads in world.allEdges. The separate whole-source road audit and north-up atlas cover scenery roads.
method: Every runtime core source physical edge, including private and mapped passages, sampled at <=2.5 m and both 90% carriageway widths; actual runtime buildingBlocksRoad includes source holes, roof height and mapped passage solids. Sidewalks and broad clearance envelopes are not road samples.
